operating_notes.text: Terminated PPA and SSHA with Ampin Energy Utility One for 40 MW hybrid renewable power due to delays, with ₹12.32 Cr investment to be refunded.
Signed 29-year PPA with EG Urja Strot to procure 65 MW hybrid power (81.4 MW solar, 102.6 MW wind, 25 MWh BESS) under captive route via 26% equity stake for ₹110.18 Cr.
Completed acquisition of Tata Steel's Kalinganagar Ferro Chrome Plant on 27 February 2026 for ₹8,610 Cr base consideration plus ₹225.03 Cr net working capital, funded fully through internal accruals.
Chrome ore inventory built to 6 lakh tons to support increased capacity
Q1FY27 domestic sales at 19%, with flexibility to shift between domestic and export markets

timeline.summary: On May 14, 2026, IMFA terminated its PPA and SSHA with Ampin Energy Utility One for a 40 MW hybrid renewable project and secured a full refund of its ₹12.32 Cr investment.
Entered into 29-year PPA and agreed to acquire 26% stake in EG Urja Strot for ₹110.18 Cr for 65 MW hybrid captive power.
Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share on May 27, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
On 27 May 2026, IMFA fixed the 64th AGM date as 4 August 2026 and record date as 31 July 2026 for final dividend entitlement.
